subject.title: feat(dashboard): workspace document + control plane (plugin backend) [1/3]

question: Should OpenClaw accept this as a default-enabled bundled dashboard control-plane plugin after the storage, undo, and actor-provenance blockers are fixed, or should the dashboard remain opt-in or external for now?
rationale: The PR introduces a new default-on product surface with persistent state, mutating gateway methods, approval/provenance metadata, and dependency-graph changes, so code fixes alone cannot decide the permanent product boundary.

options.title: Harden and keep bundled
options.body: Require the concrete storage, undo, actor-provenance, dependency-authorization, and labeler fixes, then continue reviewing this as the bundled backend foundation.

options.title: Make it opt-in or external
options.body: Keep the code path available only behind an explicit install/enablement boundary while maintainers evaluate dashboard product fit and security posture.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Close or pause the dashboard PR stack if maintainers do not want a bundled dashboard control plane in OpenClaw core right now.

recommendation.title: Harden and keep bundled
recommendation.body: Require the concrete storage, undo, actor-provenance, dependency-authorization, and labeler fixes, then continue reviewing this as the bundled backend foundation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent Logbook plugin-tab work is the closest merged Control UI plugin surface with similar product, storage, docs, and labeler implications.
